children: Clean Energy Technologies Inc. (CETY) filed a Form 8K - Unregistered Sales of Equity - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 14, 2026.

The disclosure provided above in Item 1.01 above is incorporated by reference into this Item 3.02. The Note was sold in reliance on the exemption from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, as there was no general solicitation, and the issuance did not involve a public offering.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1329606/000149315226042617/form8-k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1329606/000149315226042617/0001493152-26-042617-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
